items.title: Jackie McLean — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I thought he did a pretty decent job of putting his book out.

ctx.x: What about Talking Jazz with Ben Sidran? That was another extensive treatment.
Yeah, that was – I thought he did a pretty decent job of putting his book out. I can’t remember it now too well. I have it at home.
Another place where I encountered you, and I think it’s an important thing to talk about, is your time at the National Endowment for the Arts on the music panel.
